verdict.rationale: Spline documents built-in AI asset generation inside the editor: typed-prompt texture generation and text/image-to-3D model generation, plus an AI Agent that sets up materials. That covers the image/asset-generation slice of the story. The OpenAI API integration is a scene-runtime feature, not editor copy suggestions, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: background removal, content-aware fill, in-editor copy suggestions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI asset tools.

support.subject: As a designer, built-in AI handles asset chores — image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions — inside the editor

citations.quote: Use Artificial Intelligence to generate textures like grass, concrete, wood, ceramic, and patterns just by typing!
AI 3D Generation is a new feature in Spline that allows anyone to transform textual descriptions and 2D images into 3D models with the help of AI.

The AI Agent builds and edits 3D scenes for you. Describe what you want and it does the work through the editor itself — creating objects, setting up materials and lighting, animating, wiring interactivity
